name: Crypto.com Pay

evidence.crypto: C01: Pay accepts BTC, ETH, USDT, USDC and others on listed networks
evidence.billing: F14: automatic subscription collections, but only for customers paying from the Crypto.com App

line: Merchant crypto checkout with invoicing, subscriptions and payouts.

free.text: No setup or monthly fee published; settlement fees apply

cells.payout: Crypto credited instantly; fiat timing varies

fee.math: The merchant API states there is no transaction fee. Fees for settling payouts apply, but their rate isn't published.
